Hobgoblin Marshal (CV 31)

A field officer wears an undecorated helm and carries a map board scored with years of revised plans.

Attributes: Brawn +2; Fortitude +2; Agility +0; Guile -1; Knowledge -1; Reason +0

HP: 28 · Speed: 6 · Size: 1 (medium) · Armor DR: 2

Evasion: None · Threat: 1 Bane · Stability: 0

Weaknesses: None\ Resistances: Physical (2)\ Immunities: None

Actions

Damage and effects are Weak / Standard / Strong player defense. Each slash separates a complete outcome. All attacks use printed Threat unless stated otherwise.

Details

Command saber

Target: One adjacent creature. Player defense: Agility. Damage type: physical.

Weak defense: Push 3. Standard defense: Push 1.

Limit: Apply Stability, terrain costs and normal collision rules to the printed distance.

Make Room

A clipped order sends one companion into the opening before it closes.

One willing active ally within 3 squares that can hear it may spend that ally’s Reaction to move up to 2 squares. Movement provokes normally and pays terrain costs. An uncommanded summon cannot act; summons have no Reaction to spend.

Rally at the Blow

A sharp call catches the wounded companion's attention before pain can turn into panic.

After a visible willing ally within 3 squares takes HP damage from an attack, reduce that ally's Frightened by 1 if it can hear this creature. Then give it 1 Boon on its next defense before the start of this creature's next turn; for an NPC ally impose 1 Bane on the corresponding player attack. The defense benefit is consumed on that roll even if canceled and does not stack with itself. No healing or action is granted.

General details

Basic Melee: One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses printed Threat. No specialty riders.

Defend: Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules; repeated Defend does not stack.

Opportunity Attack: Basic Melee against the provoking creature; spend its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if capable.

Healing: Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

Senses: Ordinary sight and hearing.

Tactics and retreat: Move a willing soldier into the gap, then use the saber to preserve a withdrawal lane. Avoid spending allies' Reactions merely for appearance.

Encounter and conversation: An orderly withdrawal is a victory the marshal may accept if the wounded can leave safely.

Habitat: Settlement; frontier; contested road · Communication: Common and its community’s language

Loot: Ordinary carried gear and 8 coins; special rewards belong to the adventure.

Summoning: Ineligible.

Design notes — not needed during play
